_comment: Connector-specific edits to GENERATED files that a cli-printing-press reprint must NOT clobber. check_handfixes.py asserts every marker below is still present (and banned anti-patterns absent) and fails CI if a reprint dropped one. Provenance: project_mcp_sync_envvar_and_promote_toolsmanifest.md (reprint 2026-06-06, press 4.22.0, Level RMM).

handfixes.summary: Auth env var stays the spec canonical LEVEL_API_TOKEN everywhere; mcp-sync/promote rewrite it to the slug-derived LEVELIO_API_TOKEN, breaking MCP auth
handfixes.why: Level's spec x-auth-env-vars is LEVEL_API_TOKEN (not LEVELIO_*). config.go reads LEVEL_API_TOKEN, but press 4.22.0 `mcp-sync` derives the var from the api_name slug and rewrites manifest.json (user_config + mcp_config.env), .printing-press.json, tools.go agent hints, and tools-manifest.json to LEVELIO_API_TOKEN while config.go keeps the canonical - a silent 401 for every .mcpb/MCP user. `lock promote` re-triggers it. A reprint/polish/promote plants the bug again. The fix keeps LEVEL_API_TOKEN aligned across config.go + manifest + server + tools.go.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Fix belongs in the press: mcp-sync must honor x-auth-env-vars and never derive the auth var from the api_name slug. Filed as a retro (manuscripts/levelio/20260606-173908 findings).

handfixes.summary: doctor probes a real GET endpoint with the real credential and refuses to dial a placeholder base_url, instead of calling any HTTP response 'reachable' and never checking the credential
handfixes.why: `doctor` is the command every SKILL, guide and docs page tells an operator to run to confirm the connector works, and it could not tell a working install from a broken one. It called any HTTP response to `GET /` "reachable" and rendered it green, so a base_url aimed at the vendor's web UI (where every API path 404s) and a token rejected with 401 on every call both produced an all-green report. On this connector family it also never probed the credential at all: it printed "present, not verified" and left the operator to guess. The mirror defect: a connector whose shipped base_url default is a placeholder dialled the placeholder host, and the DNS failure rendered as "FAIL API: unreachable" - telling a correctly-credentialled operator they were broken without naming the one variable that would fix it. Several placeholder hosts resolve through live wildcard DNS and answer real HTTP, so dialling one produced a confident green verdict against a stranger's server. Measured and gated by tools/maintainer/check_doctor_truth.py. See issue #282.

handfixes.summary: every operator credential this connector reads is declared on all three install channels: manifest.json (.mcpb), server.json (MCP Registry) and mcp-install.md (manual install)
handfixes.why: Issue #282 ('three live-verified connectors prompt for the wrong credentials'). A connector is installed through THREE independent channels that each carry their own copy of the credential list: manifest.json server.mcp_config.env (what the .mcpb bundle hands Claude Desktop, which has no shell profile, no config.toml and no export - so an undeclared variable is a variable nobody is ever asked for), server.json environmentVariables (the MCP Registry publish channel), and mcp-install.md's copy-paste JSON blocks plus its remote launch line (the manual path, which never touches the bundle at all). The fleet-wide audit found 60 of 65 connectors under-declaring 122 operator-facing variables in the manifest, 61 of 65 mcp-install.md pages omitting 125, and hudu's server.json missing the base URL its manifest marks required. For levelio the manifest gained: LEVELIO_BASE_URL. server.json gained: LEVELIO_BASE_URL. mcp-install.md's env blocks gained: LEVELIO_BASE_URL. manifest.json, server.json and mcp-install.md are ALL regenerated by /msp-skills-publish on an UPDATE or re-onboard, so without this ledger a regeneration silently drops every declaration and CI stays green (check_env_schema.py is wired --warn). The asserts below name the specific credentials, not a count, so dropping one and adding another cannot cancel out.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: cli-printing-press should emit server.mcp_config.env, the matching user_config prompts, server.json environmentVariables and mcp-install.md's env blocks from ONE declaration of the connector's operator-facing environment, so the three channels cannot be generated out of step. Until then check_env_schema.py compares all three and this ledger pins them.
